Vegan Food in Mexico

By Richard Prouse · Not yet checked on the ground · Updated 2026-11-17

Draft. This guide has not yet been checked on the ground. It is hidden from search engines until it is.

Mexican food is built on corn, beans, chillies and vegetables, so many dishes are close to vegan. The catch is lard (manteca), used in beans, tortillas and tamales, plus cheese and cream on top. Learning to ask "sin manteca, sin queso, sin crema" opens up most menus.

How easyMedium
Word for veganvegano / vegana
Try firstTacos de nopales

Traditional dishes in Mexico that are vegan or can be

  • Cactus tacos

    Tacos de nopales

    Usually vegan: check

    Grilled cactus paddles; ask for no cheese.

  • Guacamole

    Guacamole

    Vegan by tradition

    Avocado, onion, chilli, coriander and lime.

  • Beans

    Frijoles

    Ask for it vegan

    Often cooked with lard; ask for frijoles de olla without manteca.

  • Street corn in a cup

    Esquites

    Ask for it vegan

    Ask for no mayonnaise, cheese or cream.

  • Oaxacan tlayuda

    Tlayuda

    Ask for it vegan

    The base is spread with asiento (pork fat); ask for a version without.

  • Green chilli tamales

    Tamales de rajas

    Ask for it vegan

    The dough is usually made with lard; vegan versions exist.

What to watch for in Mexico

  • Lard (manteca) in beans, tortillas and tamales
  • Cheese (queso) and cream (crema) on top
  • Chicken stock (caldo de pollo) in rice
  • Mayonnaise on street corn

How to ask for vegan food in Spanish (Mexico)

Show this to your server, or print it:

Soy vegano (vegana). No como carne, pescado, huevo, lácteos ni miel. ¿Lo pueden hacer sin manteca, sin queso y sin crema?

Why Mexico

Mexico is the number 6 most-visited country in the world, with 45.0 million international arrivals in 2024 (UN Tourism).
